role: Junior Estimator / Estimator - Civil, Paving & Concrete
subject: Junior Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Civilworks team,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role advertised on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Taking off pavers, bedding, kerbs and concrete slabs from civil drawings is close to the bills of quantities and cost estimates I prepared in my course, and on site I tracked procurement and kept material records. My estimating so far is coursework, not a paid estimating role, so learning directly from your General Manager is a big part of why I am applying. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

Would you be open to a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application for Junior Estimator - Civil, Paving & Concrete
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Estimator role advertised on SEEK. A role measuring and pricing paving and concrete packages for footpaths, driveways and public domain areas, with mentoring from your General Manager, is a practical way for me to build on my civil training.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. My course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against the work, tracked procurement and materials, and kept material records and progress reports.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney. My estimating experience is from study rather than a paid role, and I have not yet used take-off software, so I would value the training you offer.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
